queries.query: Benin City official land registry cadastral map Edo GIS parcel map
queries.scope: Find official Benin City land registration and parcel mapping services.
queries.result: EDOGIS Map Viewer asks the user to enter a plot file number and identifies its location at Sapele Road, Benin City. Edo State Government describes EDOGIS and land-administration agencies at its Benin City hub. EDOGIS also publishes an official request form for GIS Charting Map products by LGA/Town/City/District, and a property-registration guideline. The map viewer’s iframe was not resolvable through the public fetch path, so no anonymous parcel feature or full polygon was obtained.
queries.executionMethod: English-language web search of official EDOGIS and Edo State Government pages; attempted direct map-viewer open.
